title: DevProxy Project Config
description: Configuration for a DevProxy project, stored in .devproxy/config.json.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for editor validation and autocomplete.

name.description: Service name used to derive the .local domain. For example, 'api.myapp' becomes 'api.myapp.local'.

port.description: Local port the proxy forwards traffic to.

default.description: Path opened by 'devproxy open' with no target argument. Defaults to '/' if omitted.

targets.description: Named paths opened by 'devproxy open <target>'. Keys are target names, values are URL paths.
